physics: Geant4_Modular (OpenTOPAS 4.3 / Geant4 11.4.2): g4em-standard_opt4, g4h-phy_QGSP_BIC_HP, g4h-elastic_HP, g4stopping, g4ion-binarycascade, g4decay
EM: g4em-standard_opt4; hadronic: QGSP_BIC_HP + HP elastic + binary-cascade ions
source: 150 MeV proton kinetic energy, monoenergetic (BeamEnergySpread 0), zero-size zero-divergence pencil beam (BeamPositionDistribution None, BeamAngularDistribution None), starting at z=-0.001 mm on the beam axis x=y=0, direction +z, entering the centre of the water entrance face (z=0); same source as the V3-010B -fine/-lateral cases
geometry: G4_WATER box 400 x 400 x 320 mm (x,y centred on the beam axis; z from 0 to 320 mm) in a vacuum world 500 x 500 x 800 mm; the box is at least 1.2 R(CSDA) deep (158 mm) and holds r <= 200 mm laterally
materials: G4_WATER (Geant4 NIST material, I=78 eV, density 1.0 g/cm3)
cuts: CutForAllParticles = 0.05 mm (production range cut for gamma, e-, e+, proton)
scorers: IDD: DoseToMedium, 1x1x640 bins (one lateral bin over the full 400 x 400 mm box, so every dose deposit with |x|,|y| <= 200 mm, which contains r <= 200 mm, is summed; 0.5 mm depth bins); Report Sum, Standard_Deviation
units: IDD: TOPAS CSV with '#' header, dose in Gy (run total, Gy per NumberOfHistoriesInRun histories). Conversion in compare_idd_v5.py: energy in a bin [MeV] = Gy x bin mass [kg] / 1.602176634e-13 J/MeV with bin mass = 1 g/cm3 x bin width x/y/z read from the CSV header (400 x 400 x 0.5 mm = 80 cm3 = 0.08 kg); IDD [MeV/(g/cm2)/primary] = energy / (1e5 histories x 1 g/cm3 x 0.05 cm). The 400 x 400 mm square contains the r = 20 cm circle; its four corners (r > 200 mm, up to 283 mm) are included in the sum (their dose is negligible for a pencil beam; stated deviation from a strict cylinder). The seed in input.txt is fixed per committed seed-variant directory; see validation/reference_cases/README.md
rationale: V3-005B acceptance row V5 (absolute IDD at r = 20 cm, 150 and 200 MeV, nuclear on and off, TOPAS opt4 QGSP_BIC_HP I = 78 eV gating engine, Amendment 7 (b)): full-physics (nuclear on) 150 MeV run, seed variant 2 of 3; evidence-grade candidate (1e5 primaries, 0.5 mm depth bins, 3 distinct seeds)
